purpose: Multi-generation evolution through the composed engine: archive elites become parents, and every creature survives repeated damage/repair cycles with full lifecycle episodes between regenerations.

decision.reason: Archive elites reproduce: every creature in every generation validates, survives repeated damage/repair cycles with full episodes between regenerations, stays SLIP-aligned, and scores back into the archive; ancestry deepens generation over generation. Fitness and archive trajectories are reported as measurements, not gates.

next_research_step: Design the mecha_engine.runtime surface from this loop's evidence (decision record 0008) and study longer-horizon evolution: more generations, mutation-profile variation, and fitness trajectories under the calibrated readability score once human ratings exist.
